Page 4                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
Introduction 
This manual is prepared to help a registered Corporate Taxpayer to navigate through the Federal 
Tax Authority EmaraTax portal and make their Corporate Tax Payments.  
          
Page 5                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
Login to EmaraTax 
 
  
 
You can login into the EmaraTax account using your login credentials or using UAE PASS. If you 
have forgotten your password, you can use the 'Forgot password?' feature to reset your 
password. 
  
  

          
Page 6                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
Taxable Person Dashboard 
 
 
Step Action 
(1) Select the Taxable Person from the list and click 'View' to open the dashboard. 
  

          
Page 7                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
My Payments Section.                                                                                              
You can make your Corporate Tax Payments either in installments or in full till the payment due 
date. The following section outlines the payment process for settling corporate tax liabilities, 
either partially or in full. 
 
 
 
Step Action 
(1) Click 'MY PAYMENTS'. 
  

          
Page 8                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
 
  
 
• Currently, Corporate Tax supports payments via GIBAN and payments by cards.  
• The 'GIBAN' reference number and payment instructions are available here. 
  
  

          
Page 9                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
 
  
 
You will find all your 'Outstanding Payments' here. 
 
Note: This is your TOTAL CORPORATE TAX PAYMENT DUE tile, where you can find, Outstanding 
payments, Overdue amounts and Transactions history. 
  
  

          
Page 10                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
 
  
 
The Taxpayer has the option to make a partial payment by clicking on the ‘ Select & Pay’ option 
or to pay the full amount by clicking on the ‘Pay All' option. 
  
  

          
Page 11                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
 
 
Step Action 
(1) Click ’Select & Pay’ on the TOTAL CORPORATE TAX PAYMENTS DUE tile. Select particular amount 
from outstanding amount/overdue amounts and pay against it. 
  

          
Page 12                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
Pending Payments Section 
 
  
 
After you click "Select and Pay" from the previous step, you will land to the pending payment 
tab where You will find your ‘Total Corporate Tax Payments Due'. 
  
  

          
Page 13                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
 
  
 
• Under 'Pending Payments', you will see the 'Total Tax Liabilities' and 'Total Penalties'. 
• You have an option to download the Payment Due statement using the ' Download' 
option. 
  
  

          
Page 14                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
 
  
 
• You will find all your tax liability for each year separately in this section.  
• In case you cannot see the transaction which you need to pay against, you can expand 
the 'Showing records per page'. 
  
  

          
Page 15                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
 
 
Step Action 
(1) • You have an option to make a partial payment. 
• Enter the amount that you wish to pay now. 
  
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

          
Page 16                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
 
 
  
 To navigate back to the previous screen, click 'Back'.  
 

          
Page 17                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
 
 
Step Action 
(1) Click ’Proceed to Payment’.  
  

          
Page 18                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
 
  
 
Your 'Payment Summary' is available here. 
  
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

          
Page 19                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
 
 
 
 
You can choose between two payment methods; 'GIBAN' and 'Card Payment'. 
 

          
Page 20                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
Payment Method - Card Payment 
The following section covers ‘Card Payment Method’ for a payment process via Magnati Pay. 
 
 
 
Step Action 
(1) Choose 'Card Payment' as your Payment Method. 
 
  
  

          
Page 21                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
 
 
Step  Action  
(1)  Click ’Proceed to payment’.  
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
   

          
Page 22                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
 
 
  
Note: You will leave the FTA portal, and you will be directed to the payment portal “Magnati”.  
• Click “Yes” to proceed.  
• Click “No” to remain in select payment method section.  
 
 
  

          
Page 23                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
 
  
 
 
 
Step Action 
(1) Click 'Yes' to confirm. 
  

          
Page 24                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
 
  
 
You have multiple options to make the Payment. 
  
  

          
Page 25                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
 
 
Step Action 
(1) Enter payment details.

in Taxpayer's card local currency - as it is shown here in BHD. 
  
  

          
Page 27                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority

(1) Select the card currency in which you would like to make the payment.  
  

          
Page 28                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
 
 
Step Action 
(1) Click 'Pay'. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  

          
Page 29                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority

(1)   Click 'MY PAYMENTS'.

Step  Action  
(1)  Click ’Proceed to Payment’.

Page 37                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
 
 
Step Action

Take a note of your 'payment reference number' under payment instructions. Payment reference

Page 39                  Taxpayer User Manual – Corporate Tax Payments  Federal Tax Authority 
 
 
 
  
 
Local Transfers:

information and notify the applicant accordingly.

verification of the Taxpayer's application, the Taxpayer will receive an email notification 
setting out the information required from the Taxpayer. 
 Once the FTA confirms acceptance of the Taxpayer's application, or if the FTA rejects the 
Taxpayer's application, the Taxpayer will be notified on the decision.  
 The status of the Taxpayer's application in the dashboard will be updated accordingly. 
The Taxpayer may check the Taxpayer's application status in the dashboard from time to

Federal Tax Authority EmaraTax portal to appoint a Juridical Person Tax Agent for managing

the Juridical Person Tax Agent and submit the Juridical Person Tax Agent linking request 
application. The Juridical Person Tax Agent can accept or reject the linking request. On accepting 
the Taxpayer request, The Juridical Person Tax Agent shall be linked to the Taxable Person.
